text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a tight benchmark narrative for next week's launch. Goal: one short post, a 3-chart mini-deck, and a short webinar that funnels to a demo sign-up. Focus = latency vs token cost + clear routing guidance for inbound leads.
emily: audience? SMB devs or platform teams? that changes the tone a lot.
raj: Platform first makes sense for the data — they care about p99 & unit economics. SMB can be a follow-up blog with simplified claims.
josh: Can we commit to the numbers we'll show? rough current signals: median gen ≈ 85ms, p95 ≈ 230ms, p99 ≈ 480ms (on our hosted config). cost baseline: $0.23 / 1k tokens for default model family. happy to validate.
olga: I can pull the production slice by customer type. quick ask: do we want absolute $/1k tokens or normalized cost-per-1000-reqs?
maria: keep both. headline uses $/1k tokens, appendix shows normalized per 1k requests for typical prompt sizes.
emily: chart ideas: 1) two-axis scatter (latency on x, $/1k on y) with points per model+quantization; 2) stacked bar comparing throughput/cost for Dedicated vs Hosted; 3) tail-latency heatmap by sequence length. simple copy for each.
raj: For messaging, propose two short lines to A/B: 
- "Serve faster, pay less — predictable latency, clear unit economics."
- "Keep your app snappy without paying for idle GPU time."
Which is more platform vs SMB friendly?
emily: first is platform-forward, second is consumer/SaaS friendly. we should test both in the webinar registration page copy.
josh: technical note: if we show quantized variants, add a small footnote about quality parity regressions we measured (avg embedding cosine delta <0.002). don't oversell.
benchbot: Draft fig in Figma: https://figma.com/file/redwood/rapid-econ-drafts — page: "3panel-v1". comments open.
maria: great. owners: 
- emily: long copy + webinar script (2 slides of narrative + CTA)
- raj: 3-chart messaging + social blurbs
- josh: validate numbers + produce 1-line technical footnotes
- olga: analytics slices + conversion funnel tracking plan
ETA: 48 hours?
emily: ok I can do copy in 48h.
raj: will mock up chart labels and suggested annotations in Figma by EOD tomorrow.
josh: I'll run a fresh baseline job tonight and post results by morning.
olga: putting funnel events in GA & Segment now, will share tracking doc.
maria: inbound routing: recommend rule set for SDRs — high-throughput+low-latency prospects => Dedicated convo, high-cost-per-token users => ROI audit. we should add tags in the demo sign-up form: "priority: latency" / "priority: cost".
emily: smart. we'll add a hidden field in the reg form so we can route automatically.
raj: webinar plan: 20 min live + 10 min Q&A, demo of 2 use cases, teaser comparing 2 customers (anonymized). CTA => book demo or try hosted with promo credits.
maria: good. small checklist: short post (280-400 words), landing + reg form, 3-chart deck (5 slides max), webinar postmortem metrics, social snippets.
josh: FYI — if we publish p99 numbers include the test config: model, batch policy, region — i'll add that to the appendix.
benchbot: reminder: deploy bot will post infra metrics snapshot at publish time if you ping `#eng-runtime` with the thread link.
olga: one last ask — can we include a single example prompt and cost calc for a 500-token response? marketing loves concrete arithmetic.
emily: yes — short worked example in the post and slide 2.
maria: perfect. I'll consolidate and send a one-pager to the team after you drop the artifacts. Thanks all :raised_hands: 
raj: :thumbsup:
benchbot: :bell: scheduled calendar placeholder for dry-run set for 48h from now.
